prose: A Show HN demo automatically derives a FlashAttention kernel from about 25 lines of SQL expressing vanilla attention. The deduction rests on three portable SQL extensions the team is building: xarray-sql, a library representing petabyte-scale array datasets in the cloud as relational tables; ddx, which adds JAX-style automatic differentiation to standard SQL on that array model; and einfold, a modular query planner for fast tensor contractions in vanilla SQL. The cached page is the GitHub file view (code chrome), so the mechanism is summarized from the project's own description.
highlights: Demo derives a FlashAttention kernel automatically from ~25 lines of SQL
xarray-sql: petabyte-scale cloud array datasets as relational tables
ddx: JAX-style automatic differentiation inside standard SQL
einfold: modular query planner for fast tensor contractions in vanilla SQL
basis: Show HN description of the three SQL extensions; cache is the GitHub file page
